svg.aria-label: hack-me finds, proves, patches and re-verifies six real vulnerabilities in OWASP VAmPI, a third-party app
svg.text: hack-me · OWASP VAmPI — a third-party app we didn't write (localhost:5000)

text.tspan: http://127.0.0.1:5000 (only the URL — told nothing about its bugs)

svg.text: ✗ API3 unauth /users/v1/_debug dumped every plaintext password
✗ API1 read any user's private book secret (BOLA)
✗ API1 changed another user's password → account takeover
✗ API8 SQLi in user lookup — UNION-dumped the admin password
✗ API7 Werkzeug debugger + stack traces exposed
▸ patched root causes · replayed each exact exploit…
✓ legit happy paths still 200/204 — 6 found, proven, patched, verified
note: VAmPI's own "secure mode" flag closed only 4 of 6 —
the unauth password dump stayed open until patched.
hack-me didn't trust the flag; it replayed every exploit.
